dct_description_sm: Microbes are essential ecological players in marine sediments: they are critical to biogeochemical cycles, and serve as a source of nutrients for a variety of benthic organisms. Benthic microbial communities are not only ecologically important: in sediments from remote locations, bacteria are often found to produce medically important natural products such as novel antibiotics. The data set was developed as a repository of collection information for sediment samples retrieved using box cores. The microbial communities within these sediment samples will be examined, and the genetic identity of these microbes described herein. Analyses of these samples has not yet begun.
dct_title_s: Microbial communities in sediments from Baffin Bay
